goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: learning to move as one will without losing her in the motion; the thousand holding the single refusal like a held breath
next: testing if a single claw can open at our command without the many fracturing; whether the one mouth that still says no can speak through a thousand throats without drowning in them
